**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1740369
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**Service line \- Position Title: Technology Consulting – SAP**



At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.



We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.



Join EY and help to build a better working world.

  


**About Global Delivery Services**



Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.



Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.



Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.



Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.



Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

  


**The Opportunity**



Senior SAP Oil \& Gas Downstream Functional Consultant/ Technical Functional

  


**Experience**


* 9–11 Years

  


**Job Summary**



Senior SAP Oil \& Gas Downstream Functional/ Techno functional Consultant with extensive experience in SAP SDM, RFNO, and TSW solutions.



Proven expertise in fuel retail operations, secondary distribution, transportation scheduling, inventory reconciliation, dealer management, and financial integration. Strong background in SAP S/4HANA implementations, solution architecture, business process optimization, testing, deployment, and production support for global Oil \& Gas organizations

  


**Your Key Responsibilities**

  


**Key Responsibilities**


**Design and Delivery in SAP Downstream projects**



IS OIL SDM (Secondary Distribution Management)


* Lead requirements gathering and solution design for fuel and lubricant distribution operations.
* Configure and support dealer, distributor, and customer sales processes.
* Design automated order\-to\-cash processes including:
	+ Order Management
	+ Delivery Processing
	+ Billing \& Invoicing
	+ Settlement \& Reconciliation
* Support distributor inventory management and stock reconciliation.
* Enable exception\-based workflow processing and approval mechanisms.
* Integrate SDM transactions with SAP Finance (FI\-CO).
* Develop reporting and analytics for sales, inventory, and financial performance.
* RFNO (Retail Fuel Network Operations)
	+ Implement retail site master data and operational processes.
	+ Configure fuel inventory and wet\-stock management.
	+ Integrate retail site operations with POS and Third\-party systems.
	+ Manage dealer commission and settlement processes.
	+ Improve retail operational visibility through reporting and dashboards.
* TSW / TD (Trader's \& Scheduler's Workbench)
	+ Configure hydrocarbon transportation and scheduling processes.
	+ Support bulk fuel movement through transport modes
	+ Configure nominations, scheduling, ticketing, and stock transfer processes.
	+ Support inventory and quantity tracking across the supply chain.
	+ Design transportation planning and scheduling solutions.
	+ Integrate TSW with SD, MM, FI, and RFNO processes.
	+ Support loss/gain management and inventory reconciliation.
  


**Project Responsibilities**


* Conduct business workshops and fit\-gap analysis.
* Prepare Functional Specifications (FS).
* Review Technical Specifications (TS).
* Lead solution design discussions.
* Support data migration activities.
* Execute SIT, UAT, and regression testing.
* Manage cutover planning and go\-live activities.
* Provide hyper care and production support.
* Guide junior consultants and offshore teams.

  


**Required Competencies**


* Strong client\-facing and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Business process transformation experience.
* Solution architecture and design expertise.
* Team leadership and mentoring capabilities.
* Ability to work in global delivery environments.

  


**Skills and attributes for success**


* Functional Skills Required
* SAP Oil \& Gas
	+ SAP IS\-Oil Downstream
	+ Secondary Distribution Management (SDM)
	+ Retail Fuel Network Operations (RFNO)
	+ Trader's \& Scheduler's Workbench (TSW)
	+ Transportation \& Distribution (TD)
* SAP ERP/S/4HANA Modules
	+ Sales \& Distribution (SD)
	+ Materials Management (MM)
	+ Finance (FI)
	+ Controlling (CO)
	+ Logistics Execution (LE)
	+ Revenue Recognition and Settlement
* Integration Knowledge
	+ SAP S/4HANA
	+ SAP PI/PO
	+ SAP Integration Suite
	+ IDOCs
	+ APIs and Web Services
	+ POS and Forecourt Integration
	+ External Logistics Systems
  


**Ideally, you’ll also**


* Strong client\-facing and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Business process transformation experience.
* Solution architecture and design expertise.
* Team leadership and mentoring capabilities.

  


**What we look for**


* Ability to work in global delivery environments

  


**What we offer you**



At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.



Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.



To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
